A.question: Is the RICE effect due to the finite-state energy constraint, the Mobius decomposition, or their combination?
A.answer: No factor is a robust standalone explanation. Mobius strongly improves the energy response at D0/s0 (E_RAW-E_MOB +0.1189), but it hurts the free response on both seeds (F_RAW-F_MOB -0.0284; s0 -0.0115, s1 -0.0454). The E/F ranking flips across seeds (C3 -0.0030, CI includes 0). Every A arm is worse than R2 on the D0 two-seed mean (E_MOB -0.0525, F_MOB -0.0556, F_RAW -0.0271), and D1/s0 agrees for E_MOB/F_RAW; F_MOB is only +0.0037 better than R2 on D1/s0. Larger capacity helps F (+0.0433 s0, +0.0066 s1) but hurts E (-0.0281 s0), and F_BIG remains worse than R2. The large Mobius-vs-RAW contrast is single-seed (E_RAW only s0), so it is an internal, energy-specific signal, not a promoted effect.

B.question: With a fixed five-layer network/parameters/molecular readout, does message range beyond radius 2 improve task performance?
B.answer: No reliable improvement. FULL vs EGO2 is 0.5147 vs 0.5161 at D0/s0 (gap 0.0014, far below delta=0.01), 0.5119 vs 0.5353 at D0/s1 (gap 0.0234), 0.5803 vs 0.5563 at D1/s0 (EGO2 better by 0.0239), and 0.5517 vs 0.5523 at the D1/s1 conflict pair (gap 0.0006). The sign is not stable. Both G arms are competitive with or better than R2 on the D0 two-seed mean (+0.0287 EGO2, +0.0411 FULL), but D1/s0 FULL is worse than R2 (-0.0165) while EGO2 is slightly better (+0.0075). The fixed EGO3 trigger (s0 gap >= delta) did not fire. Local radius-2 ego encoding is sufficient; deeper range is not supported.

C.question: Can the antisymmetric transform-by-context response model predict held-out real-molecular differences and beat lookup or whole-molecule model differences?
C.answer: The transform kernel beats lookup (K_TRANSFORM 0.5446 vs EXACT_MEAN 0.6858 on D0; 0.3604 vs 0.5063 on D1), but conditional context does not add robustly: C5 K_CONDITIONAL_R2 gain over K_TRANSFORM is +0.0531 on D0 (CI [-0.0070,+0.1180]) and -0.0161 on D1 (CI [-0.0781,+0.0465]); D0 strict-new cores gain +0.0491 (CI upper +0.0092). K_CONTEXT_ID beats K_CONDITIONAL_R2 on D1 (0.3601 vs 0.3769). The best neural whole-molecule difference is better than both kernels on both splits (D0 G_EGO2_S0 0.3480; D1 G_EGO2_S0 0.3441 vs K_CONDITIONAL_R2 0.4915/0.3769). Conditional response is an internal D0 gain only, not a competitive route.
